libs.note: BH-9471 (slice C1 of #9414): before the push, the pre-PR gate (bin/lib/prepr-gate.sh prepr_scan) fetches origin's base and runs every guard suite that changed on main after the build's base commit, on the branch merged with main. A red guard is a FRESH-MAIN-GUARD finding and shares the one pre-PR fix turn. tests/fresh-main-guards.bh-9471-test.sh drives it.

knobs.zero_means: off: nothing is fetched or run, the gate records fresh-main-guards: off
knobs.note: 1 = the pre-PR gate re-runs the guards main changed after the build's base. Every failure is could-not-run, which refuses nothing. The time budget is what CI_LOCAL_BUDGET_S left after ci-local. Read by bin/lib/fresh-main-guards.sh (_fmg_on).
